title: The Girl From The Farm — EN/SN/ZU (Chas McIvor)
style: Afro-folk acoustic guitar Shona Zulu language learning warm female vocal 100bpm Zimbabwe-Australia character portrait trilingual unhurried storytelling
lyrics:
[Verse 1 - English]
She grew up where the distances are real
She helped in the dairy before school
She knew which cow needed watching
Before the cow knew it herself

[Verse 2 - Shona, with English translations]
Akakura pane nzvimbo dziri nechokwadi (She grew up where distances are real)
Akabatsira mudairy asati aenda kuchikoro (She helped at the dairy before school)
Aiziva mombe yaida kutarisirwa (She knew which cow needed watching)
Mombe isati yaziva (Before the cow knew it herself)
Akauya naZimbabwe mumoyo make (She brought Zimbabwe within her heart)
Munzira yaaigamuchira Australia (In the way she received Australia)
Kerri — akabva kuna Jeff naJill (Kerri — who came from Jeff and Jill)
Akakura muguruva dzvuku wechokwadi (Who grew up in the red dust certainty)

[Chorus - Zulu, with English translations]
Intombazane yasefamu (The girl from the farm)
Manje owesifazane nomndeni (Now the woman with the family)
Intombazane yasefamu (The girl from the farm)
Owaletha iZimbabwe eNingizimu Afrika enkulu (Who brought Zimbabwe to Australia)
Intombazane yasefamu (The girl from the farm)
UKerri — ohlahlwe nguJeff noJill (Kerri — who was formed by Jeff and Jill)
Okhule ochibini lwenhlabathi ebomvu (Who grew up in the red dust certainty)
Useyilokho, useyilokho (Still exactly that, still exactly that)

[Bridge - all three]
English: You can trace the line back — it goes straight
Shona: Unogona kutevedza mutsara — unoenda zvakatwasuka (You can trace the line — it goes straight)
Zulu: Ungalandelela umugqa — uyaqondile (You can trace the line — it goes straight)

[Outro - all three]
English: The girl from the farm — is home now
Shona: Musikana wepurazi — ari kumba zvino (The girl from the farm — is home now)
Zulu: Intombazane yasefamu — iseyikhaya manje (The girl from the farm — is home now)
